note: Reference hardware for this project is the laptop described by the fields above, running under WSL2. That is a legitimate, reproducible data point and it is labelled as one: it is not a datacentre result, and absolute numbers should not be read as one. Comparative standings are meaningful because every system is measured on this same box with the same data. `load_average` is recorded so a run taken on a busy machine can be recognised as such rather than quietly published. See docs/benchmarks/methodology.md.
